# watchpoint_ssl_monitor (Resource)

An SSL/TLS certificate monitor that connects to a host:port, validates the certificate, and alerts before it expires.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_ssl_monitor" "example" {
  name                 = "example.com TLS"
  hostname             = "example.com"
  port                 = 443
  expiry_warning_days  = 30
  expiry_critical_days = 7
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) Hostname whose certificate is checked (no scheme).
- `name` (String) Human-readable monitor name; shown across the UI and alerts.

### Optional

- `alert_on_cert_change` (Boolean) Raise an alert whenever the certificate changes. Defaults to `false`.
- `alert_profile_id` (String) Profile that controls notification channels and routing.
- `check_cert_chain` (Boolean) Validate the full certificate chain. Defaults to `true`.
- `check_interval_seconds` (Number) Seconds between checks. Defaults to `3600`. Plans cap the minimum.
- `check_revocation` (Boolean) Check certificate revocation status (OCSP/CRL). Defaults to `false`.
- `environment_id` (String) Environment the monitor belongs to (a `watchpoint_environment` id). When omitted, a new monitor joins the tenant's default environment and an existing one keeps its environment. Reads return the effective environment, so a monitor that follows the default shows the default's id.
- `expected_issuer` (String) Issuer the certificate must be issued by; a mismatch fails the check.
- `expected_subject_alt_names` (String) Comma-separated subject alternative names the certificate must include.
- `expiry_critical_days` (Number) Days before expiry at which a critical alert is raised. Defaults to `7`.
- `expiry_warning_days` (Number) Days before expiry at which a warning is raised. Defaults to `30`.
- `group_id` (String) Monitor group this monitor belongs to.
- `location_profile_id` (String) Profile that controls which regions run the check.
- `port` (Number) TLS port to connect to. Defaults to `443`.
- `sla_profile_id` (String) SLA profile attached to this monitor for uptime/latency SLO and error-budget tracking. Requires the SLA monitoring feature.
- `tags` (Set of String) Free-form tags surfaced in filters and SGL queries (`attributes.tags`). Unordered.
- `threshold_profile_id` (String) Profile that controls latency thresholds and consecutive-failure logic.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Connection timeout in seconds. Defaults to `30`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Monitor ID.
- `status` (String) Current monitor status (e.g. `Active`, `Paused`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_ssl_monitor.example mon_ssl_001
```
